description: Get latest Ethereum or Base block number via one eth_blockNumber JSON-RPC call; live state may change between calls. USE WHEN: needing chain height for sync, sequencing, or tx context. DO NOT USE WHEN: needing block data, transactions, wallet balances, gas prices, history, confirmations, or finality. For chain, use exactly ethereum or base (case-sensitive). Returns chain, block_number (decimal int), and observed_at (UTC timestamp).

chain.description: EVM network to query for the latest block number.
